review_notes: I read the whole file and the definition of `vertexSet` in Coordinate.lean. I also grepped the ErdosGinzburgZiv directory for uses of `vertexSet` and `vertexFinset`. The file's simp interface is two lemmas, `coe_vertexFinset` and `mem_vertexFinset`. Both are stated in the right direction, since they move from the Finset to the Set. They are compatible with core `Finset.mem_coe`, because both routes end at `v ∈ P.vertexSet`. I saw no competing rules, expanding rewrites or loops. The structure fields and the support theorems are not simp candidates, and tagging them would be unjustified. One possible gap is that `vertexSet` has no `mem_vertexSet` lemma for unfolding to `extremePoints`. It is unfolded by hand in only three places (VertexWeights.lean line 159, VertexHull.lean line 28, Coordinate.lean line 343). That is too little use to justify a simp attribute, and it would probably be better as a plain lemma. I found no well-supported finding. I did not run Lean, so I cannot rule out simp behaviour I did not observe.
